description: Dated Meghalaya, India, global economy and sports current affairs for MPSC/DSC/SSC/UPSC practice
sourcePolicy: Current-affairs questions link to dated reports or official releases. These are original practice questions, not official PYQs.

questions.q: According to the Meghalaya Chief Electoral Officer's release dated 12 October 2026, when was final publication of the electoral roll scheduled?
questions.e:
Correct answer: 26 October 2026.
Key points: The Meghalaya Elections Department release EL.63/2026/96, dated 12 October 2026, said more than 95% of notice hearings had been completed and preparations were under way for final publication on 26 October. This is a published schedule; check the official portal for revisions.
Why the other options are incorrect: 19 October, 1 November and 26 December do not match the release.
Exam takeaway: Electoral rolls are administered through the election machinery, including the Chief Electoral Officer and Booth Level Officers.
Source: https://www.meghalaya.gov.in/press/content/52055

questions.q: A report dated 13 October 2026 said the Central Electricity Authority's two-day AI conclave was due to begin on 14 October in which city?
questions.e:
Correct answer: New Delhi.
Key points: The report says the Central Electricity Authority was organising a two-day conclave on making India's power sector AI-enabled at the Manekshaw Centre, beginning 14 October. Topics include smart grids, renewable-energy integration and cybersecurity.
Why the other options are incorrect: Mumbai, Shillong and Bengaluru are not the venue named in the dated report.
Exam takeaway: CEA is associated with technical planning and development of the electricity sector; CERC is a separate regulatory body.
Source: https://www.freepressjournal.in/business/indias-power-sector-set-for-ai-push-as-cea-hosts-two-day-international-conclave-in-new-delhi

questions.q: In a Reuters report dated 13 October 2026, what global growth rate did the IMF forecast for 2026?
questions.e:
Correct answer: 3.1%.
Key points: Reuters reported that the IMF's World Economic Outlook projected global growth at 3.1% for 2026 and 3.4% for 2027. It noted support from AI infrastructure investment but warned about debt, conflict-related energy prices and a possible AI-investment correction. These are forecasts, not final measured growth.
Why the other options are incorrect: 2.1%, 4.1% and 5.1% are not the 2026 global forecast reported in the article.
Exam takeaway: Distinguish forecasts from actual outcomes and retain the report date.
Source: https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/imf-flags-risks-global-economy-ai-market-correction-war-debt-2026-10-13/

questions.q: A report dated 13 October 2026 discussed the Zero Defect, Zero Effect (ZED) scheme. What is its broad purpose?
o: Promote quality manufacturing while reducing harmful environmental effects
Provide free electricity to every household
Replace GST returns with a single form
questions.e:
Correct answer: Promote quality manufacturing while reducing harmful environmental effects.
Key points: ZED encourages enterprises, particularly MSMEs, to improve product quality and manufacturing processes while limiting environmental impact. A 13 October report discussed quality, technology, skills and competitiveness as priorities for Indian MSMEs.
Why the other options are incorrect: Deposit insurance is a banking function; household electricity support is unrelated; ZED does not replace GST compliance.
Exam takeaway: ZED means Zero Defect, Zero Effect—product quality plus environmental responsibility.
Source: https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-msmes-need-to-focus-on-quality-competitiveness-msme-secy-4360502/

questions.q: According to the published schedule, where was the India–West Indies fourth T20 International scheduled for 14 October 2026?
questions.e:
Correct answer: Rajiv Gandhi International Stadium, Hyderabad.
Key points: The published 2026 fixture list scheduled the fourth T20I for 14 October in Hyderabad. This question records the announced fixture, not the match result; schedules can change.
Why the other options are incorrect: Kolkata, Mumbai and Guwahati are not the venue listed for this fourth T20I in the cited schedule.
Exam takeaway: Record match number, date and venue, and distinguish a scheduled fixture from a completed result.
Source: https://sports-pp.ndtv.com/india-vs-west-indies-2026/schedules-fixtures
